plugins.name: tstack
plugins.description: Seven-skill chain that turns a rough product idea into a documented, milestone-sequenced, built project, an adoption on-ramp (tstack-ingest) for projects that already have docs, optional off-chain companions for UX design, project status, and end-of-session doc sweep, plus a manual-only autonomous runner (tstack-autopilot) that takes one milestone to an open PR and never merges.
